prompts.connect_directive: Read the applicable instruction resources linked below whose contents are due in this context. They supply shared project terms, your responsibilities and memory instructions. Components already delivered unchanged in this context are omitted by the delivery service.
prompts.connect_rules: Understand the goal through the project before acting. Use project evidence and responsible roles to resolve consequential unknowns; route decisions that require the user through the PM. Use the simplest adequate approach. Keep changes relevant to the assignment. Establish the requested outcome and the evidence that will show it.

prompts.a2a_card: Metaform holds the functional map of a project and puts agents to work on it. Send work as a message: it becomes a ticket at the Address of the element it concerns, worked by an agent with what the map knows there. Name that Address as the contextId under the Address extension; without one, Metaform answers with the Addresses that fit and you reply with one.
prompts.a2a_skill: Opens a ticket at an Address of the project's map; the message's text is the task, and an agent reads the map there, plans its steps, makes the change and records what it learned. The task is submitted while the ticket waits and working while an agent has it, also while it waits on Metaform's person, which metadata waitingOn says; it ends completed with the resolution as an artifact, canceled or failed. It is input-required only when Metaform asks you which Address the work concerns. Send with returnImmediately and follow the task with SubscribeToTask or a push notification: a ticket can take hours, so a send that waits returns after at most seconds.
prompts.a2a_skill_example: Make the kitchen timer's alarm louder: the cook misses it over the extractor fan.
prompts.a2a_extension: With this extension a message's contextId is an Address in the project's map, such as code.manager.route, and the ticket opens there; the map must hold it. Metadata under this extension's URI may give the ticket's title, its kind (broken, flawed or enhancement), and, replying to a task that asks for an Address, the address chosen.

prompts.catalog_tool: Find the Metaform tool for what you want to do, by purpose. With nothing, it lists the categories your role may open, each with what it is for. With category, it opens that one: its tools are listed to you in place of the last category's, so you carry only the tools your task needs. With search, it finds tools in any category from words for what you want to do. With tool and arguments, it runs one.
prompts.catalog_tool_unkeyed: Find the Metaform tool for what you want to do, by purpose, and get the session handle your calls pass, so each tool's guide is given you once. With nothing, it lists the categories your role may open, each with what it is for. With category, it says that category's tools. With search, it finds tools in any category from words for what you want to do. With tool and arguments, it runs one.
prompts.catalog_category: The category to open; its tools are listed to you in place of the last one's.
prompts.catalog_category_unkeyed: The category whose tools to read, each with the arguments it takes.
prompts.catalog_search: Words for what you want to do; the tools that fit, from every category, best first.

prompts.catalog_arguments: The arguments of the tool named in tool.

prompts.category_orient: Find and read the part of the project you work on: an Address's element, what it receives and provides, its layers, items and history, and the project's terms.
prompts.category_ticket: Work a ticket: read it, plan it, report each step, close it, link the files you change, and answer the questions left at nodes.
prompts.category_remember: Read and record what happened in the work at a node, as memory on its receiving element.
prompts.category_coordinate: Reach the other agents: see who is at work where, send a note to an agent, a part of the map or a file, and send work to A2A peers.
prompts.category_change_map: Change the map: refine an element or join, build knowledge layers and add terms, promote a join, show or hide layers, or open a verification pass that adds a part the map lacks.
prompts.category_intake: Map the AUE into its elements and purpose records: the intake procedure, its schema, and the calls that record and finish it.
prompts.category_steer: Start, follow, message and stop agents, and read their sessions, signals, spend and roles.
prompts.category_show: Show the person the map on Metaform's web page, and act on it there with a body.
prompts.category_workflow: Run and author Axiom workflows and skills.
prompts.category_setup: Set up Metaform for this folder: settings, registration, bases, stored prompts, origins and variants, and module repositories.
prompts.category_report: Report a fault in Metaform, read the reports kept, and read a module's full instructions or a tool's guide.
